content: Head CT angiography (CTA) may be indicated for 1 or more of the following:

children.content: Aneurysm or arteriovenous malformation, known or suspected, as indicated by 1 or more of the following:
Follow-up of known aneurysm or arteriovenous malformation
children.question: Is there documentation in the medical record of a follow-up for a known aneurysm or arteriovenous malformation?

children.content: Initial evaluation of suspected aneurysm or arteriovenous malformation (eg, acute severe headache or diagnosis of intracerebral or subarachnoid hemorrhage)
children.question: Is there documentation of an initial evaluation for a suspected aneurysm or arteriovenous malformation in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Intracerebral hemorrhage, known, and hematoma expansion suspected
children.question: Is there documentation of intracerebral hemorrhage with suspected hematoma expansion in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Postoperative evaluation of intracranial aneurysm after surgical therapy
children.question: Is there documentation of a postoperative evaluation of an intracranial aneurysm after surgical therapy in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Preoperative or preprocedural planning prior to endovascular therapy (eg, coiling, embolism)
children.question: Is there documentation of preoperative or preprocedural planning prior to endovascular therapy for an aneurysm or arteriovenous malformation in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Subarachnoid hemorrhage, and evaluation of possible intracranial vasospasm needed
children.question: Is there documentation of subarachnoid hemorrhage and evaluation of possible intracranial vasospasm needed in the patient's medical record, considering the presence of an aneurysm or arteriovenous malformation, known or suspected?

children.content: Intracranial arterial dissection, suspected
children.question: Is there documentation in the medical record indicating a suspicion of intracranial arterial dissection?

children.content: Intracranial arterial occlusive disease, suspected, when imaging results will impact patient management
children.question: Is there evidence in the medical record of suspected intracranial arterial occlusive disease where imaging results will impact patient management?

children.content: Intracranial vasculitis, suspected
children.question: Is there documentation in the medical record indicating suspected intracranial vasculitis?

children.content: Intracranial venous occlusive disease, suspected
children.question: Is there evidence in the medical record of suspected intracranial venous occlusive disease?

children.content: Preoperative planning for delineation of vascular supply of vascular neoplasm
children.question: Is there documentation of preoperative planning for delineation of vascular supply of a vascular neoplasm in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Preprocedural planning for carotid endarterectomy or percutaneous intervention for acute stroke, when performed in conjunction with neck CTA
children.question: Is there documentation of preprocedural planning for carotid endarterectomy or percutaneous intervention for acute stroke in conjunction with neck CTA in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Screening for cerebral artery aneurysm in patient with 1 or more of the following:
Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease
children.question: Is there documentation of autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Two or more family members with intracranial aneurysm or subarachnoid hemorrhage
children.question: Does the patient have two or more family members with intracranial aneurysm or subarachnoid hemorrhage?

children.content: Tinnitus, pulsatile
children.question: Is there documentation of pulsatile tinnitus in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Traumatic injury to cervicocerebral vessels, suspected
children.question: Is there documentation in the medical record of a suspected traumatic injury to cervicocerebral vessels?

children.content: Vascular malformation of brain or skull base, for confirmation of diagnosis or preoperative planning
children.question: Is there documentation of a vascular malformation of the brain or skull base for confirmation of diagnosis or preoperative planning in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Repeat evaluation of specific area or structure with same imaging modality, and ALL of the following:
Clinical need for repeat imaging, as indicated by 1 or more of the following:
Change in clinical status (eg, worsening symptoms or new associated symptoms), and findings may impact treatment
children.question: Is there documentation of a change in clinical status, such as worsening symptoms or new associated symptoms, that may impact treatment in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Need for interval reassessment that may impact treatment plan
children.question: Is there a documented need for interval reassessment that may impact the treatment plan, specifically for repeat evaluation of a specific area or structure with the same imaging modality, or for head CT angiography (CTA)?

children.content: Need for re-imaging either prior to or after performance of invasive procedure
children.question: Is there a documented need for re-imaging either prior to or after the performance of an invasive procedure in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Prior imaging results of specific area or structure with same imaging modality documented and available for comparison
children.question: Are prior imaging results of the head with the same imaging modality documented and available for comparison?
